description: Boundary case: 0 DZD payment. Should be rejected by the entry factory (require amount > 0) — both engines must reject identically.

then._comment: T-419 / TEST-308 (2026-09-27): the canonical behaviour for a zero-amount payment is REJECTION on every platform — desktop entry factory (src/domain/calc/ledger/entries.ts require input.amount > 0), the SQL RPC collect_and_allocate_payment (migration 0034: 'Validate amount > 0 (matches canonical require(amount > 0))'), and the Kotlin mirror all reject identically. The previous then-block expected a no-op success state (totalOutstanding 10000000, no allocations) — a stale expectation contradicting the scenario's own description; corrected per issue #22 section 1/2 (audit the tests themselves; trace expectations to the canonical contract).
